chunks: Yet they attribute to God what they find detestable; and their tongues assert the lie that for them is only good. On the contrary, there is Fire for them, and they will be thrown into it.
ai.seo_question: What do the hypocrites attribute to God and what is their ultimate fate?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the hypocrisy of those who attribute divine attributes they reject to God, specifically the disbelievers who claim exclusive favor while deserving punishment. The phrase 'they are the losers' (mufraṭūn) underscores their ultimate failure and loss in the Hereafter due to their verbal falsehoods and inner disbelief. This serves as a critique of those who use religious rhetoric to mask their true rejection of divine justice.
